why: not to be moved from a purpose
the food given from the sky
the upright posts of a door
the ridged sea shell and the corn weed
the sarpa fish named only for itself
the parietaria that grows on walls
the erithacus with a red breast
the asparagus shoot like a spear
the cross of a horse and a donkey
the one who keeps the house
the lavandula grown for its scent
the gobius fish named only for itself
a grammar term and not a meaning
the sale to the highest offer
the holding of people as slaves
